name: multi-company-portal
description: Multi-company login portal that hosts the FinTrack financial app per tenant, with master/staff accounts.
whatsNew: The How-to guide now also covers Bank Block — the entry type used to clear a frozen bank's tracked balance.
It explains why a bank is always required for this one, and how the money moves the opposite way from Store/Mistake.
The guide's "All entry types" section is now fully caught up with the app, in English, 中文 (Chinese) and ភាសាខ្មែរ (Khmer).
